suggestions.title: Optimize Critical Image Loading
suggestions.description: Enhance load performance for LCP elements via improved fetch priorities.
suggestions.implementation: Use JavaScript to set high fetchpriority on crucial images within 'scripts.js'.

suggestions.title: Address Unused JavaScript
suggestions.description: Significantly reduce unused JavaScript code by integrating tree shaking in the build process.
suggestions.impact: Expected INP improvement of at least 100ms
suggestions.implementation: Utilize tree shaking and code-splitting techniques for scripts, especially for 'auth0-spa-js'.
suggestions.codeExample: async function loadDeferredScripts() { const deferredScripts = ['auth0-spa-js/2.0/auth0-spa-js.production.js']; deferredScripts.forEach(async src => { await loadScript(src, { async: true }); }); } loadDeferredScripts();

suggestions.title: Defer Non-essential Third-Party Scripts
suggestions.description: Shift 'auth0-spa-js' scripts found early in execution to deferred loading when possible.
suggestions.impact: Potential improvement in user input responsiveness.
suggestions.implementation: Load 'auth0-spa-js' in a delayed phase, ensuring no critical functionality is hindered.
